think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether any numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) are documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/enable/auto/sentinel behavior) rather than just scaling the same behavior. 3) If such sentinel values exist, classify as a special knob and record those values; otherwise classify as non-special.
